key_insight: DemoPSD improves on-policy self-distillation by adaptively blending teacher and student distributions with a disagreement-driven reverse-KL barycenter, reducing privileged-information leakage while preserving exploration.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical training strategy for LLM reasoning systems that aims to improve cross-domain robustness without sacrificing token-level supervision efficiency.
method: Compute the discrepancy between teacher and student distributions at each token position.
Use disagreement to adaptively set a reverse-KL barycenter target instead of matching the full teacher distribution.
Train the student toward this selective target to attenuate leakage and maintain exploration capacity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive experiments on SciKnowEval across four scientific fields, with better performance than GRPO and SDPO, higher training entropy, and stronger out-of-distribution generalization on GPQA.
watch_item: The adaptive barycenter and discrepancy estimation add implementation complexity, and results may depend on how reliably the disagreement signal is computed during training.
